description: Cross-platform terminal and session manager with web/file browsers and AI. Every connection you have, in one window. Written in Rust and Svelte.
notes: Sessions, tabs, trusted host keys and settings live in $persist_dir (XTERMIUM_HOME),
so updates and reinstalls keep them. 'scoop uninstall --purge xtermium' deletes them.
Set a recovery passphrase (Settings > Security): it opens them if the keychain entry is lost.
